purpose: Experimental reconstruction of licensed public OSM amenity counts; no preference or rental outcome prediction
input: log1p occupied approximate 1km cell object counts, standardized with training-only population mean/std
selection: Minimum validation mean squared standardized reconstruction error over rows x six features; exact ties follow candidate order. Within a run retain first epoch achieving minimum observed validation error.
checkpoint: Training-only fitted weights; no all-cell refit
holdout_policy: Trainer never opens test feature file. Independent evaluator scores frozen export once; no retuning afterward.
replay: Repeat selected candidate from the same seed to selected epoch and compare canonical model tensor SHA256
